def transform(grid):
    R=len(grid); C=len(grid[0])
    rc=[sum(1 for c in range(C) if grid[r][c]==4) for r in range(R)]
    cc=[sum(1 for r in range(R) if grid[r][c]==4) for c in range(C)]
    mr=max(rc); mc=max(cc)
    r0=rc.index(mr); c0=cc.index(mc)
    out=[[0]*C for _ in range(R)]
    for c in range(C): out[r0][c]=4
    for r in range(R): out[r][c0]=4
    return out

foils.code:
def transform(grid):
    R=len(grid); C=len(grid[0])
    fr=[r for r in range(R) if all(grid[r][c]==4 for c in range(C))]
    fc=[c for c in range(C) if all(grid[r][c]==4 for r in range(R))]
    out=[[0]*C for _ in range(R)]
    if fr:
        r=fr[0]
        for c in range(C): out[r][c]=4
    if fc:
        c=fc[0]
        for r in range(R): out[r][c]=4
    return out
